question: Can local range+valid learn stable 128D z_role and outgoing-direction/count/role semantics on ten unseen topology parents?
method: Replacement execution of frozen B1 direction-only and M1 shared circular CNN multitask training for seeds 0/1/2, max 30 epochs/patience 6. The only repair is complete environment-probe stdout/stderr evidence and at most one retry after 2 seconds.
baseline: B0 frozen RangeExitBaseline validation F1=0.7957087771542015 and B1 direction-only learned ablation; M1 must be assessed across all three seeds.

user_authorization.scope: One replacement Gate-2 execution containing B1/M1 seeds 0/1/2 on sealed V2R train/validation, <=30 epochs each; runner probe observability/retry repair only; zero strict-test/M-TARE/graph/planner.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied '继续' after the pre-training launch failure, exact repair and replacement-execution boundary were presented.

acceptance_criteria: All frozen source/tool/environment hashes and 19338-entry V2R seal match before optimizer construction.
Environment probe preserves stdout/stderr/return code for every attempt and performs at most one retry after two seconds; persistent failure stops before training.
Exactly B1 and M1 seeds 0/1/2 execute with <=30 epochs and patience 6 over 100000 train/12500 validation frames; C10/M-TARE reads are zero.
Each child preserves best/last checkpoints, epoch log, complete validation outputs, explicit semantics metrics and representation stability.
Aggregate gate result follows the frozen Data Card thresholds without post-hoc changes.
Complete <=4 hours and <=8GiB; graph/planner/M-TARE changes remain zero.
stop_conditions: Any source/split/environment hash drift, two failed environment probes, nonfinite loss, child failure, timeout, disk overrun, C10/M-TARE read, missing evidence or need to change data/model/loss/seed/threshold stops the run.
expected_evidence: Environment probe attempt manifest and per-attempt stdout/stderr logs.
Six child model directories with checkpoints/logs/validation outputs.
Per-seed direction/role/count/z_role/stability metrics and three-seed summary figure.
Environment/source seals, raw logs, aggregate Gate result, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: RTX 5090; replacement B1/M1 x seeds 0/1/2, max 30 epochs, PyTorch 2.9+cu129; no C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
